paragraphs: QQQ is +1.05% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -7/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: open +5 → now -7 (deteriorated 12 points).

The main live drivers are The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.812% (+2.5 bp vs prev close). Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 5.125%, +4.2 bp since the opening snapshot. Mega-caps are supportive: After-hours · 7-stock basket +0.71% | 6/7 positive | QQQ -0.01% | relative +0.72 pp. It changed from mixed to positive after the baseline snapshot.
The upside move is broadly confirmed by Nasdaq internals (semiconductors positive, mega-caps positive, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require a sustained 10Y move back below roughly 5.05%, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by the 10Y remaining above 5.05% or extending higher, semiconductor leadership rolling over, a material volatility expansion.
